body_markdown:
*Turning functional fixtures into design-forward accents made to be seen*


ST. PAUL, Minn.


, Sept. 21, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- For decades, Command™ Brand has been known for making trusted hanging solutions that are designed to blend seamlessly into the background. Now, Command Brand is stepping to the forefront of home design with the **Command™ DÉCOR Collection** , a new line of premium metal fixtures created to be seen, not hidden.


Inspired by the growing desire to make every detail of a home feel intentional, the collection brings together real metal construction, sophisticated gallery-inspired finishes and Command Brand's signature damage-free hanging technology. The result turns everyday fixtures into purposeful design accents that add style and function to any space.


"The Command DÉCOR Collection represents an evolution for Command Brand, bringing together the function consumers know and love with design they'll want to show off," said Tate Galvin, global vice president, Home Improvement, 3M. "We know consumers want their spaces to feel personal and thoughtfully designed, down to the smallest details. With the DÉCOR Collection, we're making it possible to express that personal style while still delivering the practicality and versatility Command Brand is known for."


Available in Brushed Brass, Light Beige, Matte Black and Chrome, the Command DÉCOR Collection transforms functional fixtures into elevated design accents for every room. From creating a welcoming entryway and displaying curated collections to bringing greenery to an empty wall or creating a spa-inspired bathroom, the collection offers versatile solutions that make function part of the design.


The collection includes:


- **Command Large and Small Metal Hooks:** Refined solutions for hanging coats, bags, hats, accessories and jewelry, ideal for creating an elevated entryway.
- **Command Metal Wall Planter:** A stylish way to bring greenery to walls, complete with a removable plastic insert for easy watering.
- **Command Metal Key Rail:** A sleek, tool-free solution for keeping keys organized and within reach.
- **Command Metal Wall Shelf:** A durable display and storage solution for curated décor, keepsakes and everyday essentials.
- **Command Large Towel Hook and Small Robe Hook:** Water-resistant bath organizers that bring a polished, spa-inspired aesthetic to the bathroom.


Made with quality cast metal, each fixture delivers a premium look and feel while providing the strength needed for everyday hanging and organizing. Small hooks support up to 2 pounds, while larger hooks and shelves support up to 5 pounds. Each fixture also uses Command Brand's damage-free hanging technology, allowing consumers to hang items securely without nails, screws or tools and remove them without leaving marks or holes. This makes it easy to reorganize, refresh a space or adapt to life's next chapter without compromising on style.


The Command DÉCOR Collection is now available at retailers nationwide and online.


Explore the full collection and find design inspiration at[www.command.com/decor](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4779078-1&h=4120016704&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.command.com%2F3M%2Fen_US%2Fcommand%2Fdecor%2F&a=www.command.com%2Fdecor) or follow @Command on Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and Facebook for styling ideas and the latest design trends.
